centralAchievement: 1529 Zurich Froschauer VD16 W2119, a contemporaneous print of Marburg Articles, directly viewed its printed Article 15 and its Article 13 text through institution PDF page screenshots.

observations.observedMainPrint: The last lines of Article 13 contain an assertion that a teaching forbidding priests' marriages is a devilish teaching.
observations.minimumAnchor: pfaffen Ehe verbüet / Tüfels leer sye
observations.unread: No complete diplomatic character-by-character transcription of all Article 13 words or marginal handwritten notes.
observations.archivalRelation: Zürich official catalogue records article 13 addition in signed Z absent signed K; resemblance does not alone establish derivation of W2119 from Z.

observedPrintedSegments.shortAnchor: Das auch die Mässe nit ein werck ist
observedPrintedSegments.translation: The mass is not a work by which one person obtains grace for another, living or deceased.
The parties had not at that time reached agreement on whether Christ's body and blood were bodily present in the bread and wine.

observedPrintedSegments.summary: The printed article also affirms shared eucharistic statements, spiritual reception, and mutual Christian love despite unresolved disagreement.

observations.archivalRelation: The printed mass clause corresponds in theme to Z-only article 15 addition described in the Zürich official archival catalogue; cannot equate print with Z signed autograph without collating both.
observations.claimScope: 1529 W2119 Article15 printed reading, not exact original K/Z autograph reading

inspection.method: Web PDF screenshot tool, visual reading of printed page pixels
inspection.remainingWork: Acquire PDF bytes or image exports to calculate checksums; complete article-specific diplomatic German transcript and critical comparison with signed Z/K and other 1529 print editions.

studyImpact: Raises V459 W2119 print witness evidence tier from catalogue-only to actual photographed 1529 page main text reading.
Supports presence of mass-grace wording within a 1529 Zurich print, instead of solely later modern translation/official manuscript catalogue.
Supports article 13 priest marriage sentence in the same 1529 print.
Does not imply the Z signed manuscript page was directly seen or that all W2119 text is identical to Z.
Requires user-facing historical source labels to explicitly say 1529 Zürich W2119 print and exact photographed page instead of conflating K and Z.
